Test Scenario: Hardware Power-On Reset State
Test Description: Assert hardware reset (rst_n_i=0) and verify default register states: SPICR=0x00000180 (FIFOs held in reset), SPISR=0x00000005 (TX and RX FIFO empty flags asserted), SPITFOR=0, SPIRFOR=0.
Expected Result: All SPI registers initialize to reset defaults; spi_cs_n_o drives 1'b1 (inactive); spi_clk_o drives 1'b0 (Mode 0 idle); no spurious serial transitions.

Test Scenario: Software Reset Register Verification (SPI_SRR)
Test Description: Write 0x0000000A to SPI_SRR register (offset 0x40). Verify that soft reset clears active transfers, flushes both internal FIFOs, and resets control registers.
Expected Result: Software reset sequence executes; SPICR reverts to 0x180; TX/RX FIFO occupancy registers reset to 0; serial pins return to inactive state.
External Interface / Signal Names: None (Internal AHB/AXI-Lite Register Interface; SPI pins held inactive)

Test Scenario: Register Read/Write Access & Bit Masking
Test Description: Perform read/write access to SPI control and configuration registers (SPICR, SPISSR, SPI_RCLK, SPI_IER). Verify writable bits can be modified and read-only status bits (SPISR, SPITFOR, SPIRFOR) are protected.
Expected Result: Writable registers retain written data; read-only registers ignore write cycles and reflect real-time hardware status without bus error.

Test Scenario: Single-Byte Master Transmit in SPI Mode 0
Test Description: Configure SPICR with CPOL=0, CPHA=0, Master=1, SPE=1. Write 8-bit payload 0xA5 (10100101b) into SPIDTR (offset 0x68).
Expected Result: spi_cs_n_o asserts low; 8 clock pulses generated on spi_clk_o; spi_mosi_o shifts data MSB-first (1,0,1,0,0,1,0,1) with setup before rising edge; spi_cs_n_o deasserts high upon completion.

Test Scenario: Single-Byte Master Receive in SPI Mode 0
Test Description: Initiate transfer by writing SPIDTR. External SPI VIP drives MISO test pattern 0x5A (01011010b) sampled on rising clock edge. Read SPIDRR register (offset 0x6C).
Expected Result: External pattern 0x5A correctly shifted into RX FIFO; SPISR RX_Empty flag deasserts; SPIDRR read returns 0x5A with zero bit errors.

Test Scenario: Master Transmit/Receive in SPI Mode 1 (CPOL=0, CPHA=1)
Test Description: Configure SPICR with CPOL=0 and CPHA=1. Write 0x3C to SPIDTR. External VIP drives 0xC3 on MISO with phase 1 timing.
Expected Result: Idle clock is low; data shifted on leading rising edge of spi_clk_o and sampled on trailing falling edge; full duplex transfer succeeds with SPIDRR returning 0xC3.

Test Scenario: Master Transmit/Receive in SPI Mode 2 (CPOL=1, CPHA=0)
Test Description: Configure SPICR with CPOL=1 and CPHA=0. Write 0x96 to SPIDTR. External VIP drives 0x69 on MISO.
Expected Result: Idle clock is high; data sampled on leading falling edge and shifted on trailing rising edge; serial framing matches Mode 2 specifications.

Test Scenario: Master Transmit/Receive in SPI Mode 3 (CPOL=1, CPHA=1)
Test Description: Configure SPICR with CPOL=1 and CPHA=1. Write 0x55 to SPIDTR. External VIP drives 0xAA on MISO.
Expected Result: Idle clock is high; data shifted on leading falling edge and sampled on trailing rising edge; received data in SPIDRR matches 0xAA.

Test Scenario: Programmable Clock Divider Timing (SPI_RCLK)
Test Description: Program SPI_RCLK divisor values (e.g., 2, 4, 8, 16). Measure spi_clk_o output period across transfers.
Expected Result: spi_clk_o frequency scales precisely according to system clock divided by programmed ratio; duty cycle remains 50% without pulse distortion.

Test Scenario: Manual vs Automatic Slave Select Control
Test Description: Test manual slave select assertion via SPISSR bit 0 toggle versus automatic chip select assertion driven by transfer initiation in SPICR.
Expected Result: When in manual mode, spi_cs_n_o follows SPISSR register state; when in automatic mode, spi_cs_n_o asserts low during transmission and returns high when idle.

Test Scenario: Multi-Byte Continuous Stream Burst Transfer
Test Description: Write 4 sequential bytes (0x11, 0x22, 0x33, 0x44) into SPIDTR before transmission completes. Monitor serial bus.
Expected Result: spi_cs_n_o remains asserted low across all 4 byte frames (32 consecutive clocks); bytes transmitted in FIFO order with zero inter-byte gaps.

Test Scenario: SPI Loopback Mode Transfer Verification
Test Description: Configure external MISO line tied directly to MOSI line (external loopback). Transmit random 8-byte payload from CPU via SPIDTR.
Expected Result: Each byte transmitted on spi_mosi_o is simultaneously received on spi_miso_i and captured in SPIDRR; all 8 bytes match transmitted data exactly.

Test Scenario: TX FIFO Full Condition & Overflow Protection
Test Description: Disable SPI core (SPE=0) and write 16 consecutive bytes into SPIDTR until SPITFOR reaches maximum depth 16. Attempt to write a 17th byte.
Expected Result: SPITFOR clamps at 16; SPISR[1] (TX_Full) asserts high; 17th byte write is ignored without corrupting existing FIFO data; no internal pointer corruption.

Test Scenario: RX FIFO Full Condition & Status Indication
Test Description: Transmit 16 consecutive bytes from external VIP without reading SPIDRR. Monitor SPIRFOR and SPISR.
Expected Result: SPIRFOR increments to 16; SPISR[3] (RX_Full) asserts high; SPISR[0] (RX_Empty) remains 0; core reports FIFO full condition.

Test Scenario: TX & RX FIFO Empty Status Flags Validation
Test Description: Verify SPISR[2] (TX_Empty) and SPISR[0] (RX_Empty) after reset and after draining both FIFOs.
Expected Result: TX_Empty asserts high whenever TX FIFO holds 0 bytes; RX_Empty asserts high whenever all received bytes have been read from SPIDRR.

Test Scenario: Clock Divider Minimum and Maximum Frequency Limits
Test Description: Configure SPI_RCLK to minimum supported divisor (fastest clock) and maximum divisor (slowest clock). Transmit test pattern.
Expected Result: Serial clock operates reliably at maximum frequency limit and minimum frequency limit with proper setup/hold margins and no runt pulses.

Test Scenario: Mode Fault (MODF) Detection & Recovery
Test Description: Force external contention on slave select line while configured as master. Monitor SPISR Mode Fault flag.
Expected Result: SPISR[4] (MODF) asserts; SPI core disables transmitter (SPE forced to 0); serial pins released to high-impedance/safe state; core recovers after SPISR read and re-enable.

Test Scenario: TX FIFO Write Attempt When Core Disabled
Test Description: Clear SPICR[0] (SPE=0) and attempt to write data to SPIDTR.
Expected Result: Write is accepted into FIFO or suppressed per IP specification, but no clock or chip select activity occurs on external SPI pins until SPE is enabled.

Test Scenario: Read Attempt from Empty RX Data Register (SPIDRR)
Test Description: Perform read from SPIDRR when SPIRFOR is 0 (RX FIFO empty).
Expected Result: Read completes normally with OKAY response on AHB bus; returns dummy/stale data (0x00); SPIRFOR remains 0; no bus hang occurs.

Test Scenario: TX FIFO Empty Interrupt Assertion & Clearance
Test Description: Enable TX_Empty interrupt in SPI_IER. Drain TX FIFO by completing pending serial transfers.
Expected Result: spi_irq asserts high when TX FIFO becomes empty; writing a new byte to SPIDTR or masking in SPI_IER clears spi_irq immediately.
External Interface / Signal Names: None (Internal Interrupt Signal: spi_irq to PIC extintsrc_req[3])

Test Scenario: RX FIFO Not-Empty Interrupt Assertion & Clearance
Test Description: Enable RX_NotEmpty interrupt in SPI_IER. External VIP drives a byte on MISO.
Expected Result: spi_irq asserts high as soon as 1st byte is pushed to RX FIFO; reading SPIDRR drains FIFO and deasserts spi_irq.

Test Scenario: PIC External Interrupt Source 3 Integration & ISR Service
Test Description: Enable SPI interrupt source 3 in VeeR PIC (MEIE bit 3). Trigger spi_irq via serial transfer completion.
Expected Result: extintsrc_req[3] asserts; VeeR core traps to external ISR vector; ISR reads SPIDRR and writes MEIGWCLR(3); core returns cleanly via mret.
